title: Emotion & Language
description: Learn how emotional language shapes perception and influences how we interpret news and information.

title: Framing Bias
description: Discover how the same facts can be presented in ways that lead to very different conclusions.

title: Source Credibility
description: Develop skills to evaluate the reliability and credibility of sources cited in news articles.

title: Loaded Language
description: Identify words and phrases that carry implicit bias and emotional weight beyond their literal meaning.

title: False Balance
description: Understand how presenting 'both sides' can sometimes create misleading equivalence between unequal positions.

title: Confirmation Bias
description: Explore how our existing beliefs shape what information we seek out and how we interpret it.

title: Agenda Setting
description: Examine how media outlets decide what stories to cover and how that shapes public discourse.

title: Statistical Manipulation
description: Learn to spot misleading use of statistics, charts, and data in news reporting.
